name: Niizuma Shino
source: Original sequel for Shino’s route in Niizuma Koyomi, set a few years after Soushirou becomes the professional potter he wanted to be. Soushirou and Shino got married with little fanfare back then, they didn’t have a proper honeymoon as Soushirou was focused on his training as a ceramist and Shino quietly supported him as an understanding wife, now Soushirou feels he and Shino deserve that long pending honeymoon, with that he books a trip for two to a cozy Inn to enjoy themselves as a happy couple.
translation: 《新妻历》中志乃路线的原创续集，故事发生在宗四郎成为他想成为的职业陶艺家几年后。当年宗四郎和诗乃结婚时并不大张旗鼓，他们并没有度过一个像样的蜜月，因为宗四郎专注于他的陶艺师训练，而诗乃则默默地支持着他，作为一个善解人意的妻子，现在宗四郎觉得他和诗乃值得等待这个漫长的蜜月，于是他为两人预订了一个舒适的旅馆，享受幸福的情侣。
